detailed_descriptions.en: A strange phone call has invaded the peace of Grandpa… Only you have the power to rescue the mistress so Grandpa can return to chill in his house. The neighborhood is now your fight arena for an epic fight to rescue the mistress, kill all the enemies! Can you rescue the mistress? Campaign Grandpa will have a visually stunning retro third person action adventure campaign that will keep you on the edge of your seat, with semi open linear level environments with very good world building and storytelling. Grandpa will have intensely gratifying gameplay experience blending Retro graphics with modern third person mechanics. Free DLC: The game includes the Free DLC inside the game and the 2nd Free DLC is currently in development.
